extra: ('Are supply positions in different Morpho Blue markets (same loan token but different collateral, oracle, IRM, LLTV) one fungible asset or distinct assets with different risk?', 'supply:morpho')
('Is the ERC4626 _asset a plain ERC20, or could it be fee-on-transfer/rebasing so that amounts credited by Morpho and the vault differ from amounts moved?', 'asset')

('mm:asset', 'skim(address) accepts any token: can it be the vault asset or the mm share token itself, and is any idle vault asset balance meant to belong to share holders rather than the skim recipient?')

("MetaMorpho supplies to several Morpho Blue markets (different collateral, oracle, IRM, LLTV) that only share the loan token; is supply:morpho one fungible asset, or should each market's supply position be treated as a separate asset with its own risk and liquidity?", 'supply:morpho')

('Fee shares are minted as mm to feeRecipient during fee accrual; it cannot be settled from this code whether feeRecipient is an independent party or one of the owner/curator roles, which affects who absorbs the dilution.', 'mm')

('The vault asset is an arbitrary ERC20 chosen at construction; the code cannot settle whether it is a standard token (no fee-on-transfer, rebasing or callback behavior), which affects whether deposited, supplied and withdrawn amounts match.', 'asset')

('asset', "skim(address token) sends the vault's entire balance of an arbitrary token to skimRecipient; the code does not exclude the vault asset itself, so it cannot be settled whether idle vault asset (donations, or asset held mid-operation) is meant to belong to share holders or to the skim recipient.")

("Markets removed from the withdraw queue via submitMarketRemoval/updateWithdrawQueue may still hold a MetaMorpho supply position that no longer counts in totalAssets; is that leftover position still part of the shareholders' claim?", 'supply:morpho')

('Each Morpho Blue market Id is a separate supply position with its own collateral token, oracle, IRM and LLTV; the code sums them in totalAssets as one value, but whether they should be treated as one asset or one asset per market (with different risk) cannot be settled from this code.', 'supply:morpho')

('The vault asset is an arbitrary ERC20 set at construction; whether it is fee-on-transfer, rebasing or otherwise non-standard (which would break the asset/share accounting and Morpho supply amounts) cannot be determined from the code.', 'asset')

('asset', "skim(address) sends the vault's whole balance of an arbitrary token to skimRecipient with no check that the token is not the vault asset (or the mm share itself); idle asset held by MetaMorpho is not counted in totalAssets, so is idle asset owned by shareholders or by the skim recipient?")

item.text: Owner and guardian functions in the code (setCurator, setIsAllocator, setSkimRecipient, submitTimelock, submitGuardian, acceptTimelock, acceptGuardian, revokePendingCap and others) are not in the OPERATIONS list, yet they decide who can steer funds and how long the timelock is.

Owner and guardian functions in the code (setCurator, setIsAllocator, setSkimRecipient, submitTimelock, submitGuardian, acceptTimelock, acceptGuardian, revokePendingCap and others) are not in the OPERATIONS list, yet they decide who can steer funds and how long the timelock is.
